questions.q: In which 1975 comic did Storm debut?
questions.why: Storm debuted in Giant-Size X-Men #1 as part of the new, international X-Men team.

questions.q: Which artist co-created Storm with writer Len Wein?
questions.why: Len Wein and Dave Cockrum created Storm, and she became a cornerstone of the X-Men.
Storm can control the weather and fly using her atmospheric power.

questions.q: What is Storm's real first name?
questions.why: Ororo Munroe is her birth name; Storm is her codename. Her mother was a Kenyan princess and her father an American photojournalist.

questions.q: What lasting phobia did Storm develop after her parents died in a plane crash?
questions.why: The crash that killed her parents left Ororo orphaned and permanently claustrophobic.

questions.q: As a young thief in Cairo, Storm once picked the pocket of which future mentor?
questions.why: Young Ororo stole from Charles Xavier in Cairo, long before he recruited her.

questions.q: Who voiced Storm in X-Men: The Animated Series (1992-1997)?
questions.why: Alison Sealy-Smith voiced her in the 1990s cartoon and returned in X-Men '97.

questions.q: In which year did Storm adopt her punk mohawk look in Uncanny X-Men #173?
questions.why: Storm famously swapped her flowing locks for a mohawk in 1983.

questions.q: Which actress played Storm in the 2000 X-Men film?
questions.why: Halle Berry played Storm in the Fox X-Men films, and Alexandra Shipp later took over the role.

questions.q: Which mutant inventor built the weapon that stripped Storm of her powers in the 1980s?
questions.why: Forge created the device that took away her powers, and they later had a relationship.

questions.q: What is the name of Storm's magical hammer in the comics?
questions.why: Stormcaster is a magical hammer Storm wields, separate from Thor's weapons.
